rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip code, matching to a single user ID before proceeding. It retrieved the user’s orders, confirmed the specific order, and checked its status (pending) to ensure modification was allowed. The agent inspected product details, proposed a replacement item stated to be the cheapest available, and clearly presented the exact change and refund amount, requesting explicit confirmation before making any changes. After receiving consent, it executed the modification via the tool, which returned the updated order with the new item and a refund transaction. The agent then accurately summarized the update and the refund amount ($17.99) to the user. No policy violations or unsupported claims are evident, and the user’s request was completed end-to-end in line with policy.
